review_evidence: README identifies a Lean formalization of PDE topics intended to build a reusable toolbox for PDE research and education.
The primary modules cover heat kernels, heat-equation solutions and their properties, a heat maximum principle, Sobolev/Lp/Hk spaces, weak derivatives, and an orthonormal-basis lemma.
These are direct mathematical definitions and theorems; no current-primary source was shown to be content-free or exactly redundant, so no hard exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the full PDE formalization covering heat equations, function spaces, weak derivatives, and supporting analysis.
